FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
deopt-string-concatenation: deoptimize concatenation when used as an expression statement to better support es5-shim
log-from-plugin-simple: prints logs from plugins via input options if there are no handlers
perf-supports-object-hooks: Supports object hooks with perf=true
inlined-namespace-static-resolution: statically resolves Symbol.toStringTag for inlined namespaces
handles-stringified-sourcemaps: handles transforms that return stringified source maps (#377)
transpiles-react-global: transpiles JSX for react
return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
nested-namespace-member-expression: handles accessing members of namespaces correctly
load-resolve-dependencies: allows to wait for dependency resolution in this.load to scan dependency trees
redeclare-catch-scope-parameter-var-outside-conflict: throws when redeclaring a parameter of a catch scope as a var that conflicts with an outside binding
pure-comment-scenarios-simple: correctly handles various pure comment scenarios
redeclare-catch-scope-local-variable-function: throws when redeclaring the parameter of a catch scope as a function
array-spread: tracks elements of arrays with spread elements
system-export-declarations: Renders declarations where some variables are exported
deoptimize-request-treeshaking-pass: makes sure to request additional passes when a variable is deoptimized
object-expression-shadowed-properties: do not remove calls to object expression methods that may have side-effects when properties may be shadowed
hoisted-declarations: includes hoisted declarations when control flow is broken
export-from-external: exports directly from an external module
minimum-hash-size: throws when the maximum hash size is exceeded
